game the wheel of starts: take turns to spin and read the situation. how would you start the chat? say it, then tap to check.

questions round 2: your real life. have the same kind of chat.

cards.sig: are you still watching crown street? 1 you and a colleague both started season 3 of crown street a few weeks ago. оба начали давно — смотрит ли ещё, не бросил(а)? → are you still watching…?
are you still watching that crime series? 2 a colleague started a long crime series last month. you wonder: has she given up on it? начала давно — продолжает ли? → still watching.
did you see the star kitchen final last night? 3 the star kitchen final was on tv last night. было вчера, время названо → past simple: did you see … last night?
did you see the match last night? 4 there was a big football match on tv yesterday evening. было вчера вечером → did you see…? (yesterday evening → обычно говорят last night)
have you seen the new season yet? 5 a new season of a comedy series came out on friday. уже вышло — а ты уже посмотрел(а)? → have you seen … yet?
have you seen silent harbour yet? everyone's talking about it. 6 everyone's talking about silent harbour, a new film. it came out last week. новое, только вышло → yet.
have you ever seen friends? 7 you love friends, a comedy series from the 90s. does your colleague know it? старый сериал — опыт вообще → ever. yet — про новое, что только вышло.

have you ever seen back to the future? 8 your favourite film is back to the future, a classic from the 80s. you want to recommend it to a colleague. классика, опыт за всю жизнь → have you ever seen…? (ever можно опустить)

questions.6.sig: 1 start a chat about something you're watching or following right now (a series, a show, a tournament). use one of the four starts. then ask each other two more questions.
2 tell your partner about something you watched or read in one go — or something that took you ages to finish. your partner asks what you thought of the ending.
3 then finish the chat politely: anyway, i'd better…
